findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_portfolio, query_signal_history · Private data: get_decision_track_record, get_credit_balance, get_transparency, prepare_gift_link, fund_gift_link, get_signal_track_record_summary, analyze_token, check_token_risk, get_token_verdict, get_token_price, get_token_traders, find_new_tokens, check_portfolio, get_defi_yields, get_wallet_profile, subscribe_alerts, get_track_record · Public sink: send_feedback, prepare_gift_link, fund_gift_link, analyze_token, get_token_verdict, get_token_traders, get_funding_rates, get_dividends, get_fails_to_deliver, subscribe_alerts, backtest_signals, manage_alert_subscription, query_signal_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_portfolio, query_signal_history · Private data: get_decision_track_record, get_credit_balance, get_transparency, prepare_gift_link, fund_gift_link, get_signal_track_record_summary, analyze_token, check_token_risk, get_token_verdict, get_token_price, get_token_traders, find_new_tokens, check_portfolio, get_defi_yields, get_wallet_profile, subscribe_alerts, get_track_record · Public sink: send_feedback, prepare_gift_link, fund_gift_link, analyze_token, get_token_verdict, get_token_traders, get_funding_rates, get_dividends, get_fails_to_deliver, subscribe_alerts, backtest_signals, manage_alert_subscription, query_signal_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
